Policy prose home: .claude/skills/orchestration/SKILL.md section 5. The ladder in .claude/reference/model_ladder_evidence.md owns role SEMANTICS and the Anthropic-transport mapping; this file owns per-transport resolution. A bare alias names the CURRENT version of its family on every route; a superseded version keeps its row under a versioned alias (opus5, sol56, luna56). A version move is therefore an edit here: a new row that takes its family's roles and effort (effort.measuredVersion names the predecessor), an alias remap and an aliasHistory boundary. The ladder's family row needs no edit until a cell or an owner ruling shows the new version differs. `prior` is an intake input (frontier|mid|small), never a measurement: rows without an owner statement take their tier. Validate with: python3 .claude/tools/model_registry.py --check

modelAttestation._comment: A proxied child CANNOT report which model served it. Claude Code's system prompt asserts a Claude identity, so the arm parrots it; worse, a run with CCP_CODEX_MODEL forcing gpt-5.6-luna reported `modelUsage: [gpt-5.4-mini]` — the child's own pin, not the served model. Any void-check reading modelUsage mislabels the arm. The proxy's own capture is the only valid attestation.

serverSidePins._comment: Model and effort are forced at the PROXY, not via the child's --model, so a role-name pin cannot silently redirect an arm: this transport's alias surface accepts `opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku`/`fable` and full `claude-*` ids as aliases onto GPT models, inverting DeepSeek's behavior of hard-erroring on them. opencode._comment: OpenCode Zen FREE tier (https://opencode.ai/zen) — keyless (`Authorization: Bearer public`; any other unauthenticated key 401s, measured 2026-08-22). ONE shape: the proxy path — Zen's own Anthropic surface (/v1/messages) serves free models TEXT-ONLY (any request carrying `tools` upstream-errors [1210] on every free id tested) while its OpenAI surface (/v1/chat/completions) carries function-calling, streaming and tool loops, verified end-to-end including a real `claude` child completing tool-bearing work. Proxy is LiteLLM (uv tool install 'litellm[proxy]' --with 'fastapi<0.120'; newer fastapi removed get_flat_dependant and this LiteLLM imports it), started PER DISPATCH from a generated config pinning exactly one deployment under the requested id — unknown ids fail routing loudly ('No deployments available'), there is NO alias surface, so unlike the codex transport the child's own modelUsage.canonicalModel IS trustworthy identity evidence. costModel is marginal-usd WITH $0-AUTHORED PRICES because the calls ARE $0 (`cost:"0"` in every Zen response); the legal costModel set has no 'free', and plan-quota would require a quota-capable capacityProbe nothing here can satisfy — so costUSD 0.0 in records is measured truth, not the pricing artifact it would be on a priced model. Privacy: Zen documents some free ids as permitted to train on submissions during their free period — check its Privacy section before dispatching proprietary material. ONE row on this transport (muse) is Contributor-Free rather than anonymous-free: it needs a real logged-in-account key (credentialVar below), trains on submissions by design, and 500s under the anonymous `public` bearer — see the muse model row's own comment.

The launcher reads this field and builds litellm_params.model as 'openai/responses/<id>' instead of 'openai/<id>' -- the litellm prefix that forces the Responses call type end-to-end verified through a live proxy on the Anthropic Messages surface, not just the SDK. A small max_tokens (native Claude Code dispatches never send one) starves the reasoning-token budget on this call type and fails distinctly (`max_output_tokens` error, not a 500) -- unrelated to the apiMode fix itself.
